Excellent Indian food
Oct 2026 • Couples
If you fancy a change from Vietnamese food while you’re in Ninh Binh, this is definitely the place to go! 🇮🇳❤️

The food was absolutely delicious — everything was fresh, full of flavour and cooked perfectly. The portions were generous, the service was lovely and the whole meal was fantastic from start to finish.

After eating Vietnamese food for most of our trip, we fancied a change tonight and honestly couldn’t have picked a better place! 😋

Would highly recommend this restaurant if you’re looking for a really good Indian meal in Ninh Binh. We loved it! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Indian food as a moroccan
Oct 2026 • Family
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We had a really great experience at Kadhai Indian Restaurant in Vietnam! The food was delicious, flavorful, and freshly prepared. Everything we ordered was really satisfying and authentic.

The service was also excellent — everyone was friendly, welcoming, and attentive throughout our meal. After traveling around Vietnam, it was especially nice to find such a good Indian restaurant with both great food and great hospitality.

Definitely recommend this place if you’re looking for delicious Indian food and friendly service in Vietnam! 🇮🇳❤️🇻🇳
